description: Direction 2 (reproduce the smooth target geometrically). Honest null + direction-4 confirmation. The leading geometric channel identity geom(q)=(√3/4)(ln q₀)² is FLAT across the muon/proton gap (Δgeom~1e-9) while the ladder S sweeps ~0.049 (1/u³-amplified) — confirming the #4509 picture (smooth geometry, extraction-artifact S hypersensitivity). The identity is NOT satisfied at either canonical pin: geom≈0.00471 is ~2.05× below S(muon)=0.00968 (the boost-enhancement/spin gap) and wrong-sign vs S(proton)=−0.03946. A q₀* with S=geom exists in the gap but is IVT-trivial (steep S crosses flat geom once), recorded only as a datum (~90% proton→muon), NOT evidence. The A≈2.05 gap persists (open, qou-iyj5). No fit; nothing wired.
